title: OSCAL POA&M Representational Fit Rubric
author: Nimesh Jayesh Shetty
basis: Wand and Weber (1993); Venable et al. (2016) FEDS Step 3

scoring.2: Complete — dedicated native or documented extension construct represents the element clearly
scoring.1: Partial — element representable only through generic, overloaded, or indirect construct
scoring.0: Missing — no construct represents the element

scoring_rule: Native encodings scored without custom namespace properties. Extended encodings scored with documented namespace properties available.
matrix: 5 gaps x 2 encodings x 7 criteria = 70 cells, scored in Chapter 4
